6 @MainActor
7 final class SlashMenuActionHandler {
8     private let actionHandler: any BlockActionHandlerProtocol
9     private let router: any EditorRouterProtocol
10     private let document: any BaseDocumentProtocol

12     private let mediaBlockActionsProvider: any MediaBlockActionsProviderProtocol
13     
14     private weak var textView: UITextView?
15     
16     private let pasteboardService: any PasteboardBlockDocumentServiceProtocol

18     
19     init(
20         document: some BaseDocumentProtocol,
21         actionHandler: some BlockActionHandlerProtocol,
22         router: some EditorRouterProtocol,
23         cursorManager: EditorCursorManager,
24         mediaBlockActionsProvider: some MediaBlockActionsProviderProtocol,
25         dependencies: SlashMenuActionHandlerDependencies = .original()
26     ) {
27         self.document = document
28         self.actionHandler = actionHandler
29         self.router = router
30         self.cursorManager = cursorManager
31         self.mediaBlockActionsProvider = mediaBlockActionsProvider
32         self.pasteboardService = dependencies.pasteboardService
33         self.objectDateByTimestampService = dependencies.objectDateByTimestampService
34     }
35     
36     func handle(
37         _ action: SlashAction,
38         textView: UITextView?,
39         blockInformation: BlockInformation,
40         modifiedStringHandler: (SafeNSAttributedString?) -> Void
41     ) async throws {
42         switch action {
43         case let .actions(action):
44             try await handleActions(action, textView: textView, blockId: blockInformation.id)
45         case let .alignment(alignmnet):
46             handleAlignment(alignmnet, blockIds: [blockInformation.id])
47         case let .style(style):
48             try await handleStyle(style, attributedString: textView?.attributedText.sendable(), blockInformation: blockInformation, modifiedStringHandler: modifiedStringHandler)
49         case let .media(media):
50             try await handleMediaAction(media, textView: textView, blockInformation: blockInformation)
51         case let .objects(action):
52             switch action {
53             case .date:
54                 textView?.shouldResignFirstResponder()
55                 router.showDatePicker { [weak self] newDate in
56                     self?.handleDate(newDate, blockId: blockInformation.id)
57                 }
58             case .objectType(let typeDetails):
59                 let objectType = ObjectType(details: typeDetails)
60                 if objectType.isChatType {
61                     let chatData = ChatCreateScreenData(
62                         spaceId: objectType.spaceId,
63                         analyticsRoute: .slashMenu,
64                         linkDocumentId: document.objectId,
65                         linkTargetBlockId: blockInformation.id
66                     )
67                     router.showEditorScreen(data: .alert(.chatCreate(chatData)))
68                 } else {
69                     AnytypeAnalytics.instance().logCreateLink(objectType: objectType.analyticsType, route: .slashMenu)
70                     try await actionHandler
216             )
217             
218             modifiedAttributedString.map(modifiedStringHandler)
219         case .underline:
220             let modifiedAttributedString = try await actionHandler.toggleWholeBlockMarkup(
221                 attributedString,
222                 markup: .underscored,
223                 info: blockInformation,
224                 route: .slashMenu
225             )
226             
227             modifiedAttributedString.map(modifiedStringHandler)
228         case .code:
229             let modifiedAttributedString = try await actionHandler.toggleWholeBlockMarkup(
230                 attributedString,
231                 markup: .keyboard,
232                 info: blockInformation,
233                 route: .slashMenu
234             )
235             
236             modifiedAttributedString.map(modifiedStringHandler)
237         case .link:
238             break
239         }
240     }
241     
242     private func handleActions(_ action: BlockAction, textView: UITextView?, blockId: String) async throws {
243         switch action {
244         case .delete:
245             actionHandler.delete(blockIds: [blockId])
246         case .duplicate:
247             actionHandler.duplicate(blockId: blockId)
248         case .moveTo:
249             router.showMoveTo { [weak self] details in
250                 self?.actionHandler.scheduleMutationTask { [weak self] in
251                     try await self?.actionHandler.moveToPage(blockIds: [blockId], pageId: details.id)
252                 }
253             }
254         case .copy:
255             try await pasteboardService.copy(document: document, blocksIds: [blockId], selectedTextRange: NSRange())
256         case .paste:
257             textView?.paste(self)
258         }
259     }
260     
261     private func handleMediaAction(
262         _ media: SlashActionMedia,
263         textView: UITextView?,
264         blockInformation: BlockInformation
265     ) async throws {
266         let blockId = try await actionHandler.addBlock(media.blockViewsType, blockId: blockInformation.id, blockText: textView?.attributedText.sendable())
267         
268         switch media {
269         case .file:
270             mediaBlockActionsProvider.openFilePicker(blockId: blockId)
271         case .image:
272             mediaBlockActionsProvider.openImagePicker(blockId: blockId)
273         case .video:
274             mediaBlockActionsProvider.openVideoPicker(blockId: blockId)
275         case .scanDocuments:
276             mediaBlockActionsProvider.openDocumentScanner(blockId: blockId)
277         case .audio:
278             mediaBlockActionsProvider.openAudioPicker(blockId: blockId)
279         case .bookmark, .codeSnippet:
280             break

7 enum EditorEditingState {
8     case editing
9     case selecting(blocks: [String], allSelected: Bool)
10     case moving(indexPaths: [IndexPath])
11     case readonly
12     case simpleTablesSelection(block: String, selectedBlocks: [String], simpleTableMenuModel: SimpleTableMenuModel)
13     case loading
14     
15     var allSelected: Bool {
16         if case .selecting( _, let allSelected) = self {
17             return allSelected
18         } else {
19             return false
20         }
21     }
22 }
